name: How do material lead times affect custom home construction?

mainEntity.name: How do long lead times for materials affect single-family home construction schedules?
mainEntity.text: How do long lead times for materials affect single-family home construction schedules?

acceptedAnswer.text: Material lead times often determine whether a project finishes on schedule. Even when framing and systems are moving well, the house can stall if windows, custom cabinets, specialty doors, tile, or fixtures are delayed. This is especially true for luxury projects with made-to-order products. A good builder will identify long-lead items during preconstruction and place orders early enough to match the schedule. Homeowners should also understand that changing selections late can reset lead times and push completion back. The solution is to finalize important design choices early and coordinate procurement with the construction timeline. If lead times are ignored, the project may reach a point where crews are ready but materials are not, which creates avoidable downtime and extra cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Long lead items like windows, cabinetry, tile, fixtures, and specialty doors can delay the schedule if they are not ordered early. Even if the structure is on track, the home cannot finish on time if key materials arrive late.
